verdict.rationale: Creating private, member-restricted sub-teams is a fair question for a work-management product like Asana, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions teams, sub-teams, private team visibility or team membership controls. The only permissions-related item covers scoped permissions for AI agents, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
